source.author: Anastasia Kireeva
source.work: Low-degree hardness of finding the largest clique in Erdős–Rényi graph (problems 36-38)

methods.name: CHANGE THE CATEGORY
methods.outcome: For product nulls, identified the noised spectral barycenter as the Efron–Stein/ANOVA Dirichlet Rayleigh quotient of the noised likelihood ratio; a strict sub-cutoff aggregate local conditional-variance load yields the source-style noised chi-square and TV gap for arbitrary signed/cancellative likelihood ratios.

methods.name: COUNT THE SAME THING TWICE
methods.outcome: For a uniformly planted Hamiltonian cycle, derived exact run/stabilizer cylinder probabilities and the same two-copy overlap factorial moments, producing a finite multi-stratum birth certificate and factorial/superexponential noised-tail barrier.

methods.name: FIND WHY THE ALGORITHM FAILS
methods.outcome: Mao's fixed-noise counterexample necessarily has cutoff-scale aggregate normalized one-coordinate Dirichlet load after noise; thus the signed physical-space certificate excludes Mao for an analytic reason rather than by naming the rank test.

new_results.local_dirichlet_bound: If K(q)=sum_i kappa_i(q)<=theta(D+1), theta<1, then 1+chi2(T_sqrt(q)P||Q)<=[1+q Adv^{<=D}(P,Q)^2]/(1-theta).
new_results.local_log_oscillation_bound: kappa_i(q)<=tanh^2(eta_i(q)/2), hence aggregate conditional log-oscillation supplies a physical-space sufficient certificate.
new_results.mao_failure_term: For Mao, fixed-noise strong distinction with b_1=...=b_D=0 forces liminf mu(q)/(D+1)>=1 and therefore liminf sum_i kappa_i(q)/(D+1)>=1.
new_results.hamiltonian_orbit_formula: For 1<=j<=n-3, E binom(Z,j)=(n-1)_j^{-1} sum_c (n/c) binom(j-1,c-1) binom(n-j-1,c-1) 2^c.
new_results.hamiltonian_tail: For j<=n/2, b_j q^j<=2(2 lambda q)^j/j!; the terminal half is superexponentially small for fixed lambda q.

prior_art_notes: Efron–Stein/Hoeffding product decomposition, coordinate Dirichlet energies, and conditional-oscillation inequalities are classical; do not claim these ingredients as novel.
Hamiltonian-cycle common-edge Poisson(2) asymptotics and the underlying run-count mechanism are classical; the finite orbit calculation is used as breadth evidence, not a novelty claim.
A bounded search did not locate the exact likelihood-ratio low-degree inference translation; negative search is not a novelty certificate.

next_methods.name: DUALIZE
next_methods.instruction: Relate the local-Dirichlet/log-oscillation budget to Dobrushin influence matrices, strong data-processing coefficients, transport, or approximate-tensorization constants while preserving the source polynomial grading.

next_methods.name: REPLACE FOR ALL WITH FOR TYPICAL
next_methods.instruction: Replace worst-fiber kappa_i/eta_i by a g_q^2-tilted average local influence criterion and stress rare high-sensitivity fibers.

next_methods.name: BREAK THE SYMMETRY ON PURPOSE
next_methods.instruction: Test a controlled nonproduct null and identify the commutator/error between the source polynomial degree and a Glauber-type generator rather than silently changing the degree notion.
